gpuTiming.boundaryMethod: legacy queue-span uses separate empty-compute timestamp submissions around the callback
gpuTiming.commandSpanMethod: start-marker + supplied command buffers + end-marker in one GPUQueue.submit call

metricSemantics.gpuMs: legacy alias of queueSpanGpuMs; retained for report compatibility
metricSemantics.queueSpanGpuMs: GPU timestamp span from a marker submitted before the async pass callback until a marker submitted after it returns; includes queued GPU work and may include GPU-idle time caused by host waits before the ending marker is submitted
metricSemantics.commandGpuMs: sum of explicitly bracketed command-buffer submissions made through performanceTimingScope.submit(); each start/work/end sequence is submitted atomically to the queue and excludes host gaps between submit calls
metricSemantics.hostWaitMs: explicit host-side waits recorded through performanceTimingScope.recordHostWait()/measureHostWait(); never a GPU-time substitute
metricSemantics.readbackMapLatencyMs: wall-clock latency of SM-500 timestamp readback mapAsync; diagnostic transport latency, not GPU execution time
